description: ENAER/CASA C-101 Aviojet (A-36 Halcón; the 2010 report called it a T-36) mounted on a pedestal beside a mock runway in the Parque del Avión, inaugurated 22 April 2010 by the municipality with FACh support on the site of the former Base Aérea Los Cóndores (1928-75). Demonstrators tried to set it on fire in November 2019 (FACh statement via modocharlie.com); current condition and serial need on-site confirmation.
aliases: C-101; C101; Aviojet; Halcon; T-36; T36; A36
museum_name: Parque del Avión A-36 Halcón Monument, Alto Hospicio
